questions.prompt: Which availability-set concept separates VMs according to shared power and network infrastructure?

options.explanation: Fault domains describe shared physical failure boundaries.
Update domains organize planned maintenance reboots.
A resource group is a management container, not hardware isolation.
A deployment record does not define hardware placement.

questions.prompt: A stateless application runs on one VM in availability zone 1 behind a zone-redundant Standard Load Balancer frontend. Its other dependencies can survive loss of zone 1. The application must keep serving during a zone 1 outage. Which additional deployment meets this goal? Assume all added instances have enough capacity.

options.text: Add a healthy application VM in zone 2 to the load balancer backend pool and health probe.
options.explanation: The surviving zone 2 instance can receive traffic through the resilient frontend when zone 1 fails.

options.text: Add a healthy application VM in zone 1 to the load balancer backend pool and health probe.
options.explanation: Both application instances remain in the failed zone; the resilient frontend alone cannot supply a healthy backend.

options.text: Add a healthy application VM in zone 2 but leave it outside the load balancer backend pool.
options.explanation: The replica survives, but the existing frontend has no route to it through its backend pool.

options.text: Add a healthy application VM in zone 2 to the backend pool but change the frontend to a zonal IP in zone 1.
options.explanation: The backend survives, but the zonal frontend is unavailable when zone 1 fails.

questions.prompt: An availability set has five update domains and seven VMs. Which statement about planned maintenance is correct?

options.text: Some VMs share update domains, and one update domain is restarted at a time.
options.explanation: More VMs than update domains requires sharing; maintenance is sequenced by domain.

options.text: Every VM must have its own distinct update domain.
options.explanation: Seven VMs can share the configured five domains.

options.text: All five update domains always restart together.
options.explanation: The update-domain mechanism limits simultaneous planned restart groups.

options.text: Update domain numbers guarantee ascending maintenance order.
options.explanation: Maintenance order is not guaranteed to follow domain numbering.
